Title: Welcome to Prydwen
Description: Check in at the Regent's Rise Inn, and keep an eye out for the pirate captain from the beach, Grace O'Malley.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Why nothing less thrilling than the return of the 'True Heir'! Ser Gawain is coming home after centuries to finally claim the throne of High King Artorius!
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_lookaroundShifty" priority="high" />It's a long day at this post with no relief. If someone doesn't show up soon, I'm afraid <g id="female_nodyes" />I'll have to go off into the bushes for a minute or two.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_cajole" priority="high"/>Now there's a familiar face! About time you caught up.

Title: Friends with Coin
Description: Grace O'Malley has given you the coin she owes you. Look for bargains at the Trading Post and store the excess at the Storage Shed.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Well, you got that coin I just gave you so I'd suggest you get to spending it. <g id="grace_gestureL" />Buy yourself a new blade, some new boots, whatever suits your fancy.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_secret" />You're in a new town, and you have some coin now - I'd get to spending it or stashing it myself.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_chuckle" />Lively little ditty there, kinda oversells the place, don't you think? <g id="grace_headshakeno" />I sure won't be calling this place home. <g id="grace_shrugdontcare" />But hey, aren't you popular?

Title: The Knight-Regent
Description: Grace O'Malley says a messenger came from the Knight-Regent who's requested you come see her at the keep.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Sounds like some kinda plague - people turning on their friends and neighbors <g id="grace_headshakeno" />with cold murder in their eyes.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_shifty" priority="high"//>Apparently that Knight, Ser Payne, he's about five hundred years old. I guess that explains why he's such an uptight bastard.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Ah, you must be the one from the beach. <g id="female_clasphandsrequest" />Ser Payne believes you to be honorable, and I trust his judgment, but I like to hear reports first-hand.

Title: Foreman's Fate
Description: Knight-Regent Jin Jae, knight in charge of Monarch's Bluffs, has asked you to help Allya Musa at Cynefin Mines.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Minister Lochnir has sent scouts, but they've not returned as of yet, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />and now I fear they are missing as well. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Still, he counsels patience!
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />Foreman Musa usually sends regular status reports. I hope all is well, but we need to be certain.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_waghand02" />Whoah, you. If you thought you were going to the mines, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />think again.

Title: Crisis at the Mines
Description: A worried Allya Musa wants you to rescue any surviving miners at Cynefin Mine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You're brave, I'll give you that. But we're not talking about a handful of Withered, <g id="male_converseleft" />we're talking about the whole damn mine.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> You may not be a knight, but you got courage. And if that translates into some of my miners getting out of there, I sure as hell won't complain.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Finally, a sign of hope! A brave warrior battling their way through the Withered.

Title: A Most Mysterious Tablet
Description: Elias Derit believes a strange magical tablet is causing the trouble at the mines. Destroy the tablet and the Lost Pirates who guard it.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_righthandNodeal" />Nah! I told the crew no one was to touch the damn thing… it was thrumming with some unholy energy. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />I wanted to get the Sage Moira out here to study it.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_pointBlame" />You said you'd shatter that damn tablet, and I'll be holding you to it!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />You did it, then? Shattered the tablet? God's blood! I'm glad <g id="male_shrugBrief" />I didn't send you in there to your doom. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I'd have felt bad about that.

Title: Fragments of Truth
Description: Elias Derit wants you to take back news of Hiraeth Peak to Knight-Regent Jin Jae at Prydwen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_goodnews" />Ah, Musa. She's a stubborn one, alright. I'll wager she's still waiting at the mine's entrance. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll go and try to convince her to come back to town.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Bring the news of what happened here to Prydwen and get Sage Moira to study those fragments. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Don't waste time, now.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_goodnews" />You return. Excellent. Minister Lochnir said I sent you on a fool's errand, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but I can see from your expression you bring dark tidings.

Title: Source of the Plague
Description: Knight-Regent Jin Jae asks you to bring the recovered tablet fragments to Sage Moira so she can study them for answers and to ask Minister Lochnir about the reports from the mine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Such relics are better left in the earth. The ruins of Aeternum hold dangerous secrets <g id="male_nodunderstand" />that are best left uncovered.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_realize" />At this point, we know there is a curse out there. It's time we got some answers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />You return, but without Minister Lochnir. I assume he claimed he was too busy with his preparations?

Title: Source of the Plague
Description: Knight-Regent Jin Jae asks you to bring the recovered tablet fragments to Sage Moira so she can study them for answers and to ask Minister Lochnir about the reports from the mine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Such relics are better left in the earth. The ruins of Aeternum hold dangerous secrets <g id="male_nodunderstand" />that are best left uncovered.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_realize" />At this point, we know there is a curse out there. It's time we got some answers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />You return, but without Minister Lochnir. I assume he claimed he was too busy with his preparations?

Title: Knight in the North
Description: Knight-Regent Jin Jae is beginning to trust you. She's asked you to join Ser Payne Bennett in challenging the Pirates encamped at Brysedd Shore.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />These pirates could only have come from the Brysedd Shore to the north. <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />There was a den of brigands there, and now they are apparently Lost.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />You will find Ser Payne and his squire at Brysedd Shore. I have no doubt your support will be welcome.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />Ah, you're back! I'm at a bit of a loss here. A few months ago, <g id="male_gestureright" />this barren beach had nothing but a smattering of pirates.

Title: Brigands on the Beach
Description: Ser Payne has asked you to use unusual methods to fight the filthy Lost pirates. Cut off their supplies and set their boats adrift!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_realize" />Oh, well, yes, good point. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I suppose our options will be more limited, then.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_smackfist" /> Strike a blow to the pirates' supply lines. <g id="female_nodyes" />That'll shake them up! Honor and duty, my friend, honor and duty!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Bravo, my bold friend! <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I feared the pirates would overwhelm you, <g id="male_complimentplayer" />but it seems you are nigh unstoppable.

Title: A Pirate's Plan
Description: Grace O'Malley knows what's summoning the Lost. Go into the Pirates' den and destroy the evil altar.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Very well, then. If she's to be believed, <g id="male_converseright" />the source of this plague on our lands may well be inside. You'll have to hear her account yourself.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Charging into the pirates' compound could very well be a foolhardy notion. <g id="male_compliment" />I trust your judgment, however.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" priority="high"/> No surprise there. Miss O'Malley gets what she wants and disappears. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />I do hope your courage accomplished more than padding her coin purse.

Title: Report to Prydwen
Description: Ser Payne Bennett has asked you to use the Spirit Shrine to get to Prydwen quickly and warn the Regent about the Lost Pirates.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_think" />Interesting. Perhaps that's why we're seeing even fewer of the scoundrels coming ashore than before.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> I’ll stay here to contain these foul brigands. <g id="male_compliment" />You take word to the Knight-Regent. Good fortune to you, my stalwart friend!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_willcoverit" />Hm. I have to confess, seeing you return brings me a great deal of relief. <g id="female_nodyes" />I need people I can trust… now more than ever.

Title: Relics of the Ancients
Description: Regent Jin Jae has asked you to work with Sage Moira to determine if there is any connection between the tablet from the mine and the altar in the pirate's den.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" /> Exactly. She's been studying the fragments you brought back from the mine for a while. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Surely, she's learned something.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Please. For now, let's keep this talk of Minister Lochnir between us. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Don't even speak of it to Moira.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I'm thankful to have found you, young one. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I fear I may have missed some additional clues on the fragments. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />I came after you right away.

Title: The Mystery of Minister Lochnir
Description: Moira now believes the Ancient tablet was taken from the ruins of Antares. She's asking you to search for any clues relating to the tablet, the Lost, or Minister Lochnir.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Yes, that much is clear. But we cannot leave yet. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />In my further study of the fragments, <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I saw new clues - the tablet's not from Khalladan, but rather Antares.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_think" />Controlling the Lost, why would Lochnir want to do such a thing?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Your friend Grace has come with dire news from Prydwen, but first, <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />you have to tell me what you found. Any further clues to Lochnir's plans?

Title: The True Threat
Description: Grace O'Malley has asked you to share the truth about Lochnir with the Knight-Regent at Preiddeu Farms.
PlayerPrompt: "What does she want us to do?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I don't know she's thinking that far ahead, yet. She just hopped on her horse and rode off, <g id="grace_handheart" />shouting at me to find you and meet her at Preiddeu Farms.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_concerns" priority="high" />I pray that this business turns out to be less worrisome than it seems. <g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />So much hope in the air of late, I'd hate to see it dashed.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />If you're expecting to have more luck plying me for answers than the Knight-Regent, think again. <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />I don't know you and <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I sure as hell don't owe you anything.

Title: Broken Oath
Description: The former knight Percilla Wallen suggests you investigate Teyrnon Keep to learn more about the return of the true heir, Ser Gawain.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />I believe that to be the case, though some may remain. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I left one day, and I haven't gone back.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />To be perfectly clear, I'm not advising you to visit Teyrnon Keep. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />It would be much better to walk away, find another place on Aeternum where you can be safe.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_pointBlame" />Are you happy now? If you've been to Teyrnon Keep, I'm assuming you know the truth. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Ser Gawain is Lost, and he and Lochnir <g id="male_nodunderstand" />intend to rule a Lost kingdom.

Title: Kingdom of the Lost
Description: Percilla Wallen has advised you meet Grace and stay informed of her latest findings at Deadman's Shrine.
PlayerPrompt: "I'm sure it's hard for you both."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Heh, there are some benefits to being new to the island, aren't there? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Maybe fate has ordained you to be the one to shoulder this burden.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It's too much to bear. If I dwell on all this, I'll lose hope, and then fall Lost. That may well be the fate of all on Aeternum, in the end.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="grace_welcome" />About time I got some reinforcements down here! <g id="grace_convince2" />Remember that Lost pirate den in the north? That's a small affair compared to this place.

Title: The Plot against Prydwen
Description: Stop the Lost fleet from leaving Scallywag Bay. Start with their explosives and then destroy their altar.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_proud" />Well, we've discussed this partnership before, haven't we? I get the lay of the land, and <g id="grace_smackfist" />you do the battling part.
InProgressResponse: <g id="grace_consider" priority="high"/>I'll be heading north, and I hope you'll follow soon. I look forward to hearing your stories at the Prydwen tavern.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="yonas_spreadarms002" />Surprised to see me, are you? Brushing the dirt from my armor was no easy task, <g id="yonas_noddingSlow" />but after your friend Grace told me you were here alone, I had to come.

Title: Corbenic Castle
Description: Percilla Wallen suspects Ser Gawain, the True Heir and Lochnir, the scheming minister, have gone to Corbenic Castle. Meet her there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="yonas_nodBig" />I thought you might. It is indeed best for Prydwen that the Knight-Regent is safe and fortifying the keep. <g id="yonas_handHeartLove" />You and I are more… expendable.
InProgressResponse: Meet me at Corbenic Castle. We'll put an end to all this madness!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="yonas_gesturebothhands" />Here we are, home to one of King Artorius's greatest knights, and his heir. <g id="yonas_nodSlight" />It was a bastion of valor back then… today, <g id="yonas_shrug" />it's a monument to darkness.

Title: Lost Legacy
Description: The time of judgement is nigh. Confront Ser Gawain, the True Heir and the pestilent Minister Lochnir at Corbenic Castle.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: No, but I do. <g id="yonas_rightfist" />This is my duty, and I am sworn to it. <g id="yonas_explain01" />You can attack from the gate, and I will use a hidden entrance on the other side of the castle.
InProgressResponse: <g id="yonas_nod" />Do what must be done. You're the only one who can stop them!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="yonas_explain01" />I am sorry I arrived late to Gawain's hall. The Lost knights fought fiercely, and with cold resolve. <g id="yonas_noddingSubtle" />I arrived only in time to see Lochnir fall.

Title: A True Leader
Description: Ser Gawain and Lochnir have been vanquished. In the absence of the True Heir, find a True Ruler for the crown.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="yonas_noddingheadApproval" />Of course. She has led us admirably for many decades now, <g id="yonas_lefthand" />and the people adore her, probably even more after this.
InProgressResponse: <g id="yonas_shakehead" />Do not tarry here long, my friend. The Lost will return, and even if they're less driven, they will be a threat in numbers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />I'm glad you made it. We waited as long as we could. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I think the people of Prydwen <g id="female_nodyes" />wanted to ensure all the preparations for Gawain were put to use.

Title: Wilderness Wiseman
Description: Travel east to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Jin Jae believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shocked" />You hear the voice of Corruption? I've heard legends of its insidious torment... <g id="female_sympathyHandsheart" />What an awful burden you must bear! I had no idea…
InProgressResponse: If anyone can help you, it would be that old man. <g id="female_pointleft" />He's often fishing on the river to the east. <g id="female_nodyes" />Look for him there.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Away with you, ghost. You'll scare away the fish. I remember you not and care not to, even if I could.

Title: Wilderness Wiseman
Description: Travel east to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Jin Jae believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shocked" />You hear the voice of Corruption? I've heard legends of its insidious torment... <g id="female_sympathyHandsheart" />What an awful burden you must bear! I had no idea…
InProgressResponse: If anyone can help you, it would be that old man. <g id="female_pointleft" />He's often fishing on the river to the east. <g id="female_nodyes" />Look for him there.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Away with you, ghost. You'll scare away the fish. I remember you not and care not to, even if I could.

Title: Flowers for the Heir
Description: The True Heir is returning to Monarch's Bluffs! Fiona Murphy has asked you to bring Avalon Lilies to Pendragon Landing as a tribute.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Mountain and dale speak the tale, a warrior of wit and renown. Artorius raised them strong and brave, a True Heir for his crown.
InProgressResponse: No tribute too large, no deed too small, when the fated ship comes home.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The True Heir sought to save us once, and now, the answer they’ll bring.

Title: The Anniversary Gift
Description: Edda Koning wants you to remind her husband, Eddie Koning it's their anniversary. Carry the message to Cynefin Mine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Yes, my foolish heart can't help long for my Eddie. He toils too hard in the mines.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Did you find my Eddie yet? Ask him to stop working and get here quickly!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Oh dear, he’s not with you. That can only mean…

Title: Pick of the Mines
Description: Prydwen is short on resources. Cemal, the Master Builder has asked you to retrieve the miners' picks so that he may melt them into iron.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I wish that you could retrieve the miners, such hard workers all of them, all equipped with picks that date back to Artorius's reign. Maybe you could retrieve the heirloom picks? I'd be most appreciative.
InProgressResponse: Did you get all the miners' picks? Each one if an heirloom with cuts rocks with ease. It will be simpler to train you with them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: …8, 9, 10. The miners' heirloom picks are all here, all accounted for and in good condition.

Title: Blow 'Em Down!
Description: Squire Ashe needs your help to blow up a bunch of pirates at Brysedd Shore.
PlayerPrompt: “When did you come to the island?”
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I was a baby. And an absolute terror. Folks here say I used to leap out from behind trees and startle them.
InProgressResponse: What are you waiting for? Blow up the pirates, already!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hah! That was magnifique! You're handy with gunpowder barrels! Had Ser Payne witnessed this, he might have even made you a squire!

Title: A Wife's Mirror
Description: A wistful Hugo Molina has asked you to help him find the missing fragments of his Lost wife's mirror.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It is when you’re the reason your woman is no more. Even the moon burns you. Fatimah’s soul gave up on me.
InProgressResponse: Did you have any luck with the missing fragments of Fatimah's mirror?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Gracias, kind soul! Fatimah always loved her mirrors. With this last fragment, she can have her final one.

Title: The Maidens Lost
Description: Nabi has asked for evidence to prove getting married is not the answer to turning Lost. Hopefully, this will get her meddlesome marriage-minded mother off her back.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes. Once upon a time, I was even destined to be queen. But I lost my betrothed to the sea on our way to the island.
InProgressResponse: Did you find any items that show some of the Lost used to be married once?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A talisman? To protect me from evil and lower my chances of turning into a ghost?

Title: Dentistry Artistry
Description: Hamza Killic's brain is dancing with a new idea. Collect wolf fangs so that he may bring his invention to life!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: More days than a snail has teeth. I left to pursue my great ideas in my reckless youth.
InProgressResponse: Did you get the six wolf teeth like I asked? I’ll be able to complete my brilliant invention then. Trust me, you've never seen anything as daring as this!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You spotted the wolves well - middle-aged, strong, aggressive fighters most likely.

Title: Heart of Glass
Description: A grieving Olivia Barovier has asked you to retrieve her Lost father's glassworks from Arruda Ranch.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Scars. My father's mistakes wore him down till he broke. He always thought the world was better... He shattered when he saw the truth.
InProgressResponse: Were you able to enter the house? Did you find my father’s glassworks?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Getting into the house must not have been easy. I am grateful for your courage.

Title: Ending the Madness
Description: Fixing the mirror for Hugo worsened matters. He needs your help breaking the large mirror at Deadman's Cove, so that he can finally let go of his Lost wife.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I had to. Her words are still pounding in my head.
InProgressResponse: Were you able to destroy the mirror or did Fatimah's voice get to you too? My Fatimah can be quite compelling.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: How is it that you can love someone and yet living with them can slowly destroy you?

Title: A Useless Hope
Description: Dayo Musa's hopeful plan went horribly wrong. Retrieve the amulets from the Lost to put them at ease and return the amulets to him.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I tried to guide the people towards their faith, by giving them something tangible to focus on.
InProgressResponse: The journals of Dayo Musa should really be discussed with him.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hello, friend! I hope this day is treating you with kindness.

Title: The Aspiring Knight
Description: Ashe Dubois, Ser Payne's squire, has always longed to be a knight. Give her the proof that someone in her family used to be a knight once.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The helm, the bow, and the crest of Margot will mark the Dubois family history.
InProgressResponse: The proclamation concerning the Dubois Family Crest should should be taken to Ashe Dubois.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Really? You found something that belonged to my family! What is it? Who are they? Where can I meet them?

Title: Devil Honey
Description: Get combs of Devil's Honey from Geertie Lother's private reserve at Hiraeth Lookout and return them to her in Prydwen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They say you've been quite a help, and I was like, "Well, why haven't they helped me?"
InProgressResponse: You’ll find the honeycombs at Hiraeth Lookout. Just wait until you taste this honey!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Aha! There's my honey! Er, I mean my honeycombs. I wasn't calling you "my honey." That would be... absurd.

Title: Old World Wine
Description: Celebrate while you still can. Collect jars of Old World wine from Brysedd Shore and share them with Geertie Lother.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Seeing as how everyone is talking about "battening down the hatches" here to protect against the Lost, I think we need to stock up on spirits.
InProgressResponse: Stars above! The Old World wine from Brysedd Shore! I can't wait. Pirates sure have all the best stuff!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh yeah, I can feel the party coming on already! We got wine and honeycakes - it's gonna be a feast!

Title: Resources for Prydwen
Description: Collect Stone, Wood and Leather for Cemal Qadir, Prydwen's Master Builder, so that he can build good defenses for Prydwen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well, I've run into some supply troubles. I was expecting a shipment of stone, timber, and leather this week.
InProgressResponse: Did you get everything? Not one hair of leather should be missing. Every resource counts towards fortifying Prydwen’s defenses.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Great! You brought exactly what I needed, the right type and the right amount. Were you always this resourceful?

Title: A Sword for a Friend
Description: Cemal Qadir is very happy with the work you've done and wants to do something for you in turn. Learn how to build a sword with his guidance.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Words to live by, rajal sadaq! You could be knight material and I want to see you make it through a few more summers, at least.
InProgressResponse: Craft me the best sword you can! I want to see what you’re capable of!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That's a fine-looking sword, rajal sadaq. It would almost rival the swords in Syria.

Title: The Town Project Board
Description: Visit the Town Project Board of Monarch's Bluffs and find tasks to help the people of the settlement.

Title: Down Payment
Description: Track down the workers who betrayed Giacomo
ObjectiveProposalResponse: A place of rest for weary travelers, of course! I am Giacomo Altoviti, architect. Perhaps you have heard of me? No?
InProgressResponse: Your aid is welcome, friend. Once we have my notebook, I have such plans. It will change all of Aeternum! And you will be greatly rewarded, fear not!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is that my notebook? Oh, grazie! And what of those bastardi who stabbed me and stole it?

Title: A Major Purchase
Description: Purchase a home, and place some decorations within
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It is sanctuary! A haven that beckons after a long day. It anchors you to the land. And spirit shrines can deposit you gently inside from anywhere on the island!
InProgressResponse: Raising the capital for your first home may not be easy, but I promise you, the benefits are worthwhile.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Good friend, you have returned! And looking stronger and more prosperous than before. You have made your purchase, yes?

Title: Insuring the Investment
Description: Travel to Shatterwall and the Fong Family Orchard to collect fresh Withered blood and bones for Giacomo
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Eh, of a sort. I have selected the site to prepare the foundation, but I'll need a few things.
InProgressResponse: To be honest, I'm not entirely certain how the bones and blood will work, but my Survivalist friend swears by it. I figured better safe than sorry, no?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Welcome to the site of the first Traveler's Rest! It may not seem much right now, but I promise you... it will be! Now, have you gathered those grisly bits I needed?

Title: Insuring the Investment (Part 2)
Description: Gather Grave Nettles from Nettlerest Graveyard, and bring them back to Giacomo
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Si, a plant that grows on and around gravesites. Some people still go through the ceremony for those who have become Lost.
InProgressResponse: Scuse, I do not mean to impose on you, but I am certain that when you see the result, you will be amazed.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: See my accomplishment? Amazing progress, no? The foundation is almost finished.

Title: Site Inspection
Description: Gather the construction materials for Giacomo, and investigate the information on the next traitor
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Si, si! I'm also running short of materials. I had planned this project with a work crew behind me, but we saw how that turned out.
InProgressResponse: I've almost exhausted my stockpile. But I have confidence you'll handle matters swiftly, and return with good news and packs of supplies!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Magnifico! Now, travelers have a haven from the dangers and horrors of this island. This is my dream: a home for all who need it.

Title: Mandatory Improvements
Description: Collect the materials for Giacomo's recipe, then craft the Ancient Protection Stones at an Arcane Repository
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Listen carefully - I've rediscovered how the Ancients protected some of their sites. Ah! Ah!
InProgressResponse: Because I am cautious, there are a few steps not in that recipe that I'll keep secret… at least for now. But in time, I'll share my knowledge. But not for a profit!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Bentornato! And just in time! This road is well-traveled. I've had my hands full keeping the less friendly sorts away.

Title: Closing Cost
Description: Track down Airic Niclisson, the leader of those who betrayed Giacomo
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Si, Airic Niclisson, the foreman of my treacherous crew. I'm certain he was the mastermind of their scheme.
InProgressResponse: Just preparing for the road, then I'm on my way. I hope to find Airic myself. But I'm uncertain what to do then.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Friend! Any news? You found him! What did that scoundrel say when faceded with his crimes? E fatta. He got what he deserved.
